name: @openlens-obs/web
description: OpenLens browser SDK: one dependency for product analytics by role, feature and release.

scripts.build: esbuild src/global.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/openlens.min.js && esbuild src/replay.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/openlens-replay.min.js && esbuild src/survey.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/openlens-survey.min.js && esbuild src/player.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/openlens-player.min.js && cp node_modules/rrweb/dist/style.min.css dist/openlens-player.min.css && node scripts/banner.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/index.js && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/version.mjs && node scripts/size.mjs && node scripts/test.mjs
